Keep all other outer predicates and candidate order.
preserved: All writes to localFreeFallbackAllowed occur before open-import lookup; it is unchanged throughout the loop.
When true, exact source/import/module/symbol iteration and declaration/export/name/ambiguity decisions remain unchanged.
Method selection and its diagnostics still precede this free-function fallback.
